author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Align-middle: an upright box centred on a horizontal guide that runs to both edges, a down arrow above the guide at the left and an up arrow under the box, both pointing at the guide, as in the reference. Lucide align-vertical/centre construction.
omissions: The box is shorter (12) and the arrows are short (shafts 8 and 6): the stack arrow + 8 + box + 8 + arrow fills 36 units, so the reference's tall box and long thin arrows cannot fit.
